game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard, an echoing courtyard: the relic hunter must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of rune stones while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard: an echoing courtyard
core_gameplay_loop: In Echoing Courtyard, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of rune stones while keeping the order. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the obelisk using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the obelisk is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 5 (applied tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Echoing Courtyard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
